description: NAVIGATION group slice: ChipBar, List, FilterList, NavList, Tree, Steps, Tabs, PropsList. Same stable IDs as v1/registry.json; ref_source lists reference source symbols verified present in the cited files. src/ tree is identical between ref_commit and head_commit, so cited lines hold for both.
